parameters.name: BrokerConnectionEstablished
parameters.description: Time when the MQTT broker connection was established.

parameters.name: LastPublishMessageSent
parameters.description: Time when the last publish message was sent to the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: LastPublishMessageReceived
parameters.description: Time when the last publish message was received from the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: PublishSent
parameters.description: Number of publish messages sent to the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: PublishReceived
parameters.description: Number of publish messages received from to the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: SubscribeSent
parameters.description: Number of subscribe messages sent to the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: UnSubscribeSent
parameters.description: Number of unsubscribe messages sent to the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: MQTTMessagesSent
parameters.description: Total number of MQTT messages sent to the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: MQTTMessagesReceived
parameters.description: Total number of MQTT messages received from the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: PublishErrors
parameters.description: Number of errors which prevented sending publish messages.

object.description: Contains the MQTT client statistics and usage information. The CPE MUST reset the Stats parameters after the MQTT client gets (re-)enabled or if the MQTT client connects with a new MQTT broker (e.g. {{param|#.BrokerAddress}} has changed). The CPE MAY retain the values across a reboot if it reconnects with the same MQTT broker.
